recs.title: Deal-closing actions
items: Start here: University of Alberta, MALÅ WideRange GPR (#2123), your highest-value live deal. Quote S00391 (CAD 25,749) has been a draft for 9 days while Astellog holds the unit. Confirm it and ask for the PO this week.

NPL 322 deal (new 5 Oct): the buyer decided to keep the NPL after the repair, so the sale goes ahead on updated terms (#3266/#3267). Confirm the final payment and close the opportunity in Odoo so it counts.
New opportunity #3304 'ICR' (5 Oct, Proposition, $0): add the customer, item and value. As it stands it's invisible in the pipeline. We hold 3× iCR80 5" R1000 plus an iCR80 + ICON tablet in stock.

Mike (used Trimble TX8, SX12, S6), #3286, 5 Oct: you introduced Topotrade to him. Follow up with what we have: 1 TX8 in Odoo stock, the SX12 listing #2177 ($20,125), and the SITECH S6 kits #2523/#2525/#2527. Check with Mireille first, because she has two TX8 buyers (#2928/#2919).

Robert Parsons (Ont inc), HiPer VR (#3148, Machinio): he has now waited 4 days for the 915 MHz vs UHF answer. Reply today. A new HiPer VR + FC5000 kit went live on 6 Oct (#2557, $7,135), so you can offer him a second option.
Leica DS2000 availability (#3246): you asked David whether the DS2000 is still available. Claude has a German buyer for one (#3092, $20k). Connect the two.

Stale, 30+ days: AppliedeX S00343 (CAD 40,453) has been a draft for 25 business days although the kit was delivered 24 Sep. Call Eugene to confirm or cancel. Silvia (Trimble S6, #2796) hasn't replied in 6 days, so call her.

● NavVis VLX3/VLX2 offers (#2278) and platform order #485 (Chile BLK360, US$9,483): couldn't check today, showing the last available data (30 Sep): both were waiting on us. Check them in the admin panel.
Escalation, past day 7 of the Self-Serve Nudge cadence: Saul Mamani (#789, Trimble R8s to sell) is at day 39. Call him yourself.

Your pipeline: 186 open opportunities, $210,435 expected revenue (33 open quotes, ≈$535k, most older than 5 business days). 287 New · 20 Qualified · 24 Proposition team-wide (331 open, ≈$2,370,098 expected revenue).
